title: Ronin 225 Triple Tone (Track Edition)
description: Positioned for riders seeking dedicated Urban Roadster capability, the TVS Motor Company Ronin 225 Triple Tone (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Upright Neutral posture pairs with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
